record.description: Ornithomimus was a swift, feathered ornithomimid of Late Cretaceous western North America, with long legs and a small toothless beak that hints at an omnivorous diet. It is one of the classic 'ostrich dinosaurs'.

notableFacts.text: Some specimens preserve evidence of feathers, including wing-like arm plumage.
Its toothless beak suggests an omnivorous diet.
